description: This file provides a Python class `KubectlClient` that wraps the `kubectl` command-line interface for interacting with Kubernetes clusters. It includes methods to retrieve node and pod information, execute commands inside pods, and supports a simulation layer for testing purposes.

classes.name: KubectlError
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors related to `kubectl` command failures.

classes.name: KubectlClient
classes.description: A client wrapper class for executing `kubectl` commands with options for context, namespace, additional arguments, and a simulation mode.

methods.name: None __init__( self, kubectl_path: str = "kubectl", context: Optional[str] = None, namespace: Optional[str] = None, extra_args: str = "", simulator: Optional["SimulationLayer"] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the `KubectlClient` instance with optional parameters such as path, context, namespace, extra arguments, and simulation layer.

methods.name: List[str] _base_cmd(self)
methods.description: Constructs the base command list for `kubectl` including context, namespace, and additional arguments.

methods.name: Tuple[int,str,str] _exec(self, args: List[str])
methods.description: Executes a `kubectl` command securely, capturing output and handling timeouts.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_nodes(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the list of nodes from Kubernetes as a JSON-parsed list.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_pods(self)
methods.description: Retrieves all pods across all namespaces as a JSON-parsed list.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] top_pods(self)
methods.description: Returns resource metrics of top pods if available, or an empty list if not.

methods.name: Tuple[int,str,str] exec_in_pod(self, namespace: str, pod: str, container: Optional[str], command: List[str])
methods.description: Executes a command inside a specified pod and optional container, returning the command's output.
